verses.text: Yahweh says to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool for your feet.”
lines: Yahweh says to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand,
until I make your enemies your footstool for your feet.”

verses.text: Yahweh will send out the rod of your strength out of Zion. Rule among your enemies.
lines: Yahweh will send out the rod of your strength out of Zion.

verses.text: Your people offer themselves willingly in the day of your power, in holy array. Out of the womb of the morning, you have the dew of your youth.
lines: Your people offer themselves willingly in the day of your power, in holy array.
Out of the womb of the morning, you have the dew of your youth.

verses.text: Yahweh has sworn, and will not change his mind: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”
lines: Yahweh has sworn, and will not change his mind:
“You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”

verses.text: The Lord is at your right hand. He will crush kings in the day of his wrath.
lines: The Lord is at your right hand.
He will crush kings in the day of his wrath.

verses.text: He will judge among the nations. He will heap up dead bodies. He will crush the ruler of the whole earth.
lines: He will judge among the nations.
He will heap up dead bodies.
He will crush the ruler of the whole earth.

verses.text: He will drink of the brook on the way; therefore he will lift up his head.
lines: He will drink of the brook on the way;
therefore he will lift up his head.
